bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; appropriating money for a grant to Rochester Public Schools for a school-based mental health program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal year designated.

Subd. 2.

School-based mental health program.

(a) For a grant to Independent School District No. 535, Rochester, for a school-based mental health program:

$

.......

.....

2027

(b) The grant must be used to continue activities originally funded under a school-based mental health grant awarded by the United States Department of Education, but later canceled by the department. Eligible uses of the grant include any use authorized under the United States Department of Education's original approval of the federal grant.

(c) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, up to two percent of the appropriation is available for grant administration.

(d) This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.
additions: APPROPRIATION.
Subdivision 1.
Department of Education.
The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal year designated.
Subd. 2.
School-based mental health program.
(a) For a grant to Independent School District No. 535, Rochester, for a school-based mental health program:

(b) The grant must be used to continue activities originally funded under a school-based mental health grant awarded by the United States Department of Education, but later canceled by the department. Eligible uses of the grant include any use authorized under the United States Department of Education's original approval of the federal grant.
(c) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, up to two percent of the appropriation is available for grant administration.
(d) This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.
